answer: Each agent identity signs completed work into a nonce-chained ledger where every entry embeds the previous nonce, forming one unbroken thread. A verifier consensus layer accepts only the branch with most accumulated work and anchors its head in a shared vault of checkpoints, so a clone fork dies as an orphan plume branch that no oasis of honest peers validates. Forging entries costs real compute, and since only one chain survives, that spend cannot split into parallel profitable fakes, making sybil scaling linear instead of multiplicative.
